title: WorkerListReply
description: The parsed form of a worker_list reply (the daemon's workers): one property per word of the reply, a list an array, a record an object, a whole number or a decimal one a number.

items.title: WorkerRecord
items.description: One worker of a worker_list answer.

format.description: The format the worker hosts: lv2, clap or lv2-clap.

state.description: The worker's state, a name of the table's worker_states.

core.description: The audio core, or - for a worker pinned to none.

place.description: Where the worker runs: own, default, pool:<name>, a full pool's sibling <name>#<n>, or a plan's chain:<plan>.<k>.

instances.description: The instances the worker holds, in order, each followed by ! when the pins read again refuse its files.

items.description: One item: an instance a worker holds, followed by ! when the pins read again refuse its files.
